summary: Iteration 3 regression covering (a) Transformations page removal, (b) new EVIDENCE section on Home, (c) ATHARVLIFTSs wordmark w/ dumbbell, (d) Nutrition food photos in colour vs physique B&W, (e) 5 new photo keys used across About/Programs/Contact/Footer. Backend: pytest 5/5 pass, no 500s, RESEND_API_KEY-not-set warning logged as expected. Frontend: all 6 routes render, /transformations falls back to Home (data-testid page-home present), no console JS errors, 0 truly broken images after scrolling (lazy-load loaded fine), 0 horizontal overflow at 390x844. Nav shows exactly [About, Programs, Nutrition, Coaching, Contact]; mobile overlay shows [Home, About, Programs, Nutrition, Coaching, Contact]. Wordmark reads 'ATHARVLIFTSs' (tail 's' cyan, dumbbell icon) in header on every page and mobile menu. Home has data-testid='home-standard' with backSpread photo + 'See How I Program' -> /programs; testimonial-rail present; old home-transformations-teaser is gone. Nutrition main plate (IMG.nutrition) and supplement photo (IMG.supplements) render with computed filter: none (full colour), while all other physique photos still carry the .graded class (grayscale filter). About has the two-up photo band. Contact inquiry flow works end-to-end: empty submit shows toast about missing name/contact; valid submit renders data-testid='inquiry-success' and record persists via GET /api/inquiries.
critical_code_review_comments: site.js WORDMARK constant is defined (main='ATHARVLIFTS', tail='s'), Nav renders it via a shared Wordmark component — good. Footer however hard-codes the copyright string 'ATHARVLIFTS' + cyan 's' instead of consuming WORDMARK; minor duplication, not a bug.
Footer TILES array references IMG keys directly — if a key is renamed in site.js, footer will silently render an empty . Consider filtering falsy entries.
Transformations.jsx still lives in /app/frontend/src/pages but is unimported (intentional per E1). Lint could complain; currently clean.
Home 'home-standard' image (IMG.backSpread) is not lazy — uses loading='lazy' — good, but consider fetchpriority='high' if it becomes a LCP candidate on longer screens.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_-prefixed inquiry (TEST_Iter3) inserted via the Contact form; test_inquiries.py inserts TEST_Priya via pytest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wordmark is rendered via Wordmark component in Nav; Footer duplicates the wordmark string in the copyright line. /transformations still resolves to Home due to catch-all route in App.js. Lazy images may report naturalWidth=0 until scrolled into view — always scroll before asserting broken images.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Prior iterations' fixes (ClipIn reveal, no _id in inquiry response, Resend guard) still holding.
